Manifest.Name: Eleanor Story Expand / 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展
Manifest.Author: EleanorRomance Team
Manifest.Description: 1.37 releases legacy story progress instead of pausing it. On load, old maid/revolution/dual route version fields are stamped to the current versions and the save continues with its chapter, items, Wilde projects and purchases intact; no reset is required. Common and romance saves are no longer blocked by a missing attendant version field. This is best-effort compatibility: removed old-route scenes may not replay, but the current chapter queue continues. Diagnostic logging reports the released versions and whether v2/P4 markers exist. No new story, route, choice, target-day or ending changes; the 1.36/1.35/1.34/1.33 fixes remain. 1.37 不再把旧路线进度永久暂停：读档时把旧的侍从/革命军/后宫路线版本补成当前版本，让存档带着章节、物品、王尔德项目和购买记录继续；不需要重置。共同线和恋爱线也不会再因为缺少侍从版本字段被暂停。这是尽力兼容：被删除的旧路线场景不一定重播，但当前章节会继续排期。诊断日志会记录补上的版本以及 v2/P4 标记。不新增剧情、路线、选项、目标日或结局；保留 1.36/1.35/1.34/1.33 修复。简体中文 / English / 日本語 / 한국어。
